{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check if any revenue values contain commas
print("Revenue values with commas:", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum())

# Parse revenue as float after removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if any revenue is 999999.99
print("Number of rows with revenue_float == 999999.99:", (df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Now, filter to only completed orders (exclude refunded)
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the new shape
print("Shape after filtering completed orders:", df_completed.shape)

# Check conversion rate by channel before adjusting for segment
print("Conversion rate by channel (raw):\n", df_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean())

# Check distribution of customer_segment by channel
print("Customer segment by channel:\n", df_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
